marks.label: Delimiter — detected for you, or set it when the file is unusual
Decimal mark — a point or a comma
Comment marker — drop the instrument's notes above and between the rows
Fold a units row into the names — “Time” over “s” becomes “Time (s)”
Destination — a new datasheet, or appended to one you already have
The preview is the datasheet grid — rename, reorder, retype and exclude here, before anything is created
